sponsored.t: Requires Medicaid coverage of applied behavior analysis therapy rendered during school hours
sponsored.sum: Requires Medicaid coverage of applied behavior analysis therapy rendered during school hours in certain schools.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "Prader-Willi syndrome residential stabilization and best-practice support act"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "Prader-Willi syndrome residential stabilization and best-practice support act" in relation to providing services to individuals with Prader-Willi syndrome.

sponsored.t: Designates the Nature Center at Rockland Lake State Park as the "Lauren Shields Nature Center"
sponsored.ls: Parks, Recreation and Historic Preservation Law
sponsored.sum: Designates the Nature Center at Rockland Lake State Park as the "Lauren Shields Nature Center".

sponsored.t: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system to Chief Hugh (Chaim) Jacobson
sponsored.sum: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system in the town of Ramapo, county of Rockland, to Chief Hugh (Chaim) Jacobson.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the Congregation Atzei Chaim to receive retroactive real property tax exempt status
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the Congregation Atzei Chaim to receive retroactive real property tax exempt status for the 2023 and 2024 assessment rolls and all of the 2023-2024 school taxes.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the Tovas Dovid Community Kollel, Inc. to receive retroactive real property tax exempt status
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the Tovas Dovid Community Kollel, Inc. to receive retroactive real property tax exempt status for the 2023, 2024 and 2025 assessment rolls and all of the 2023-2024, 2024-2025 and 2025-2026 school taxes.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the Congregation Divrei Chaim to receive retroactive real property tax exempt status
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the Congregation Divrei Chaim to receive retroactive real property tax exempt status for the 2023, 2024, 2025 assessment rolls and all of the 2023-2024, 2024-2025, and 2025-2026 school taxes for two parcels of land located at 67 and 71 College Road in Monsey.

sponsored.t: Authorizes Cong Kehal Square of Roman to receive retroactive real property tax exempt status
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the Cong Kehal Square of Roman to receive retroactive real property tax exempt status for the 2024 assessment roll and all of the 2023-2024 school taxes.

sponsored.t: Authorizes Simcray Holdings, LLC. to receive retroactive real property tax exempt status
sponsored.sum: Authorizes Simcray Holdings, LLC. to receive retroactive real property tax exempt status for the 2023, 2024 and 2025 assessment rolls and all of the 2023-2024, 2024-2025 and 2025-2026 school taxes.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the town of Clarkstown to establish community preservation funds and to impose a real estate transfer tax; repealer
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the town of Clarkstown to establish community preservation funds and to impose a real estate transfer tax with revenues therefrom to be deposited in the community preservation fund; provides for the repeal of certain provisions upon expiration thereof.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the town of Clarkstown in Rockland county to alienate certain lands used as parklands for the purposes of installing a cellular tower
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the town of Clarkstown in Rockland county to lease certain lands used as parklands to Homeland Towers, LLC for the purposes of installing a cellular tower.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "CR clean water and sewer authority act"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "CR clean water and sewer authority act" in relation to creating the CR clean water and sewer authority in the county of Rockland.
sponsored.fis: The bill creates an Authority with the ability to fund operations and capital needs through rates, fees, and other charges, and through bond- ing as authorized. The bill also addresses reimbursement structures relating to certain county-funded employee costs. Any fiscal impacts will be implementation-dependent and driven by operational plans, capi- tal needs, and rate-setting decisions made pursuant to the framework established by the act.

sponsored.t: Extends limitations on the shift between classes of taxable property in the town of Orangetown, County of Rockland
sponsored.sum: Extends limitations on the shift between classes of taxable property in the town of Orangetown, County of Rockland for the 2026--2027 assessment rolls.

sponsored.t: Limiting the shift between classes of taxable property in the town of Haverstraw, county of Rockland
sponsored.sum: Relates to limiting the shift between classes of taxable property in the town of Haverstraw, county of Rockland for 2026-2027.

sponsored.t: Extends limitations on the shift between classes of taxable property in the town of Clarkstown, county of Rockland
sponsored.sum: Extends limitations on the shift between classes of taxable property in the town of Clarkstown, county of Rockland for an additional year for 2026-2027.

sponsored.t: Provides pay per call and paid on call stipends for volunteer firefighters and travel expense reimbursement for call response
sponsored.sum: Allows an authority having jurisdiction over a volunteer fire department or fire company in a county, city, town, village, fire district, or fire protection district to provide volunteer firefighters with a stipend for responses to calls and for certain standby services.

sponsored.t: Relates to authorizing the village of Nyack to alienate and discontinue the use of certain parklands
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the village of Nyack to alienate and discontinue the use of certain parklands and to use the funds received for the acquisition of new parklands and/or capital improvements to existing park and recreational facilities.

sponsored.t: Grants retroactive tier IV membership in the New York state and local employees' retirement system to Karen Siegel
sponsored.sum: Grants retroactive tier IV membership in the New York state and local employees' retirement system to Karen Siegel.

sponsored.t: Authorizes Daniel Woolley to receive an accidental disability retirement
sponsored.sum: Authorizes Daniel Woolley to file for an accidental disability retirement.

sponsored.t: Relates to self-direction funding adjustments for the office for people with developmental disabilities
sponsored.sum: Requires that all funding to the office for people with developmental disabilities reflect current economic conditions; establishes mandatory minimum funding.
sponsored.fis: This bill will increase expenditures for the self-direction program proportionate to the gap between current cap levels and the COLA-adjust- ed floors established herein. The cost is bounded by the defined minimum floors and the COLA adjustment methodology, both of which are tied to existing state policy. Current caps - $3,000 for OTPS, $3,000 for FRR, $1,500 for Memberships, $4,000 for Camp, and $500 for Coaching and Education - have already been included in prior-year state budgets; this bill adjusts them to reflect the purchasing power those budgets originally intended. To the extent the bill reduces family caregiver strain and service gaps, it may also reduce higher-cost emergency inter- ventions

sponsored.t: Enacts the "Housing mobility mortgage study act"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "Housing mobility mortgage study act" to direct the commissioner of housing and community renewal, in consultation with the state of New York mortgage agency (SONYMA) to study the potential impacts of establishing a state-backed housing mobility mortgage program within the state of New York.

sponsored.t: Relates to supplemental therapeutic services reimbursement
sponsored.sum: Establishes mandatory supplemental therapeutic services reimbursement for certain individuals receiving services through the office for people with developmental disabilities.
sponsored.fis: This bill will increase expenditures for the OPWDD program. Cost is constrained by: the twenty-one-day provider-unavailability documentation requirement; the requirement that services be medically necessary and included in an approved plan; the per-hour rate caps; the CPT-U adjust- ment methodology; and utilization review and program integrity oversight by the Medicaid inspector general. To the extent the bill reduces service disruption, behavioral crises, and family caregiver breakdown, it may also prevent higher-cost institutional or emergency inter- ventions. The annual reporting requirement will allow the legislature to monitor utilization and adjust program parameters as warranted.

sponsored.t: Authorizes George Orfanoudakis to receive certain retroactive membership in the New York state and local police and fire retirement system
sponsored.sum: Authorizes George Orfanoudakis to receive certain retroactive membership in the New York state and local police and fire retirement system.

sponsored.t: Deems certain nominating or designating petitions to be permeated with fraud and invalidating the filings made by a contested candidate
sponsored.sum: Deems certain nominating or designating petitions to be permeated with fraud; invalidates the filings made by a contested candidate.

sponsored.t: Requires the refund of certain excess school taxes collected by school districts located within Rockland County resulting from erroneous tax levy increases
sponsored.sum: Requires the refund of certain excess school taxes collected by school districts located within Rockland County resulting from erroneous tax levy increases for the 2024--2025 school tax levy.

sponsored.t: Relates to missing or non-functioning airbags in vehicles for sale
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "Anthony Amoros law"; requires an automobile auctioneer, retail dealer or individual seller to disclose missing or non-functioning airbags in vehicles for sale.

sponsored.t: Relates to requirements for a course of instruction relating to the Irish potato famine
sponsored.sum: Relates to a course of instruction relating to the potato famine which resulted in mass starvation in Ireland from 1845-1850.

sponsored.t: Makes technical corrections to a chapter of the laws of 2025 relating to authorizing the Thiells-Roseville Fire District to file an application for exemption from school taxes and real property taxes
sponsored.sum: Makes technical corrections to a chapter of the laws of 2025 relating to authorizing the Thiells-Roseville Fire District to file an application for exemption from school taxes and real property taxes.

sponsored.t: Adjusts the regional labor force cost index for the Hudson Valley region
sponsored.sum: Adjusts the regional labor force cost index for the Hudson Valley region for the 2025--2026 school year and thereafter.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the commissioner of education to conduct a study regarding the mass starvation in Ireland from 1845 until 1850
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the commissioner of education to conduct a survey regarding instruction on the mass starvation in Ireland from 1845 until 1850 within the state; provides a report shall be delivered which includes detailed results of the survey, the extent the survey data submitted was compliant with section eight hundred one of the education law, and if needed, recommendations to strengthen provisions of law if not compliant.

sponsored.t: Includes "people with disabilities" within the definition of "minority"
sponsored.sum: Requires the definition of "minority" to include "people with disabilities" pursuant to the Human Rights law in order for such people with disabilities to be eligible for state contract set asides.

sponsored.t: Prohibits falsely reporting an incident and/or making a terroristic threat which include claims of a deadly weapon or dangerous instrument being involved or which threaten a school or place of worship
sponsored.sum: Prohibits falsely reporting an incident and/or making a terroristic threat which include claims of a deadly weapon or dangerous instrument being involved or which threaten a school or place of worship.

sponsored.t: Relates to authorizing a local government to override a state disaster emergency in all or part of the territorial limits of such local government
sponsored.sum: Authorizes a county, city, town or village to override a governor's declaration of a state disaster emergency in all or part of the territorial limits of such local government.

sponsored.t: Requires continuous work until completion for the design, construction, maintenance, or renovation of any transit facility, transportation facility, or equipment of the metropolitan transportation authority
sponsored.sum: Provides that in the design, construction, maintenance, or renovation of any transit facility, transportation facility, or equipment of the metropolitan transportation authority, work shall take place over a continuous period of time until such point at which the project has been completed.

sponsored.t: Relates to certain railroad penalties; repealer
sponsored.sum: Alters penalties for individuals, corporations, companies, and associations that violate rules and regulations related to braking systems, steering components, coupling devices, and the transportation of hazardous materials; makes related provisions.

sponsored.t: Enacts "Lindsey's Law"
sponsored.sum: Enacts "Lindsey's law" criminalizing the disclosure of confidential government records by a public employer as retaliation for a victim making a sexual harassment complaint or claim.

sponsored.t: Relates to the provision of certain services to students in nonpublic schools in certain school districts
sponsored.sum: Relates to the provision of certain services to students in nonpublic schools in certain school districts.

sponsored.t: Enacts "Paula's law"
sponsored.sum: Provides that being eighteen years old or more, while in the course of committing rape in the first, second or third degree, criminal sexual act in the first, second or third degree, sexual abuse in the first degree, aggravated sexual abuse in the first, second, third or fourth degree, or incest in the first, second or third degree, against a person less than eighteen years old, such defendant intentionally causes the death of such person.

sponsored.t: Relates to the creation of the "No Hate NY" license plate and the "No Hate NY fund"
sponsored.sum: Relates to the creation of the "No Hate NY" license plate and the "No Hate NY fund" to support hate crime awareness and prevention programs.

sponsored.t: Relates to alternate members of certain planning boards and zoning boards of appeals
sponsored.sum: Permits alternate members of certain planning boards and zoning boards of appeals for any reason the town board deems necessary pursuant to local law, rule, regulation or ordinance.

sponsored.t: Relates to the reimbursement of certain certification examination fees
sponsored.sum: Directs the commissioner of education to develop a program and provide for a system whereby teachers may submit examination receipts for any New York state teaching certifications earned after the first permanent teaching certification for reimbursement by the department of education for any additional certifications.

sponsored.t: Authorizes municipalities in the county of Rockland to add unpaid housing code violation penalties, costs and fines to such municipalities' annual tax levy
sponsored.sum: Authorizes municipalities in the county of Rockland to add unpaid housing code violation penalties, costs and fines to such municipalities' annual tax levy in accordance with applicable law.

sponsored.t: Permits schools to allow trade unions to make a recruitment presentation in a high school
sponsored.sum: Requires the principal of any high school to allow any local trade union, upon request, to enter the school for the purpose of trade union recruitment, including, but not limited to: making presentations; disseminating literature; and answering questions by students.

sponsored.t: Exempts from compensating use taxes purchases made outside the state and brought into the state
sponsored.sum: Exempts from compensating use taxes purchases made outside the state and brought into the state to the extent that the value of the purchase does not exceed $2,500.

sponsored.t: Requires enhanced federal medical assistance percentage funds be directly shared with the counties and the city of New York
sponsored.sum: Requires enhanced federal medical assistance percentage funds be directly shared with the counties and the city of New York; requires the comptroller examine and audit all funds received from the enhanced federal medical assistance percentage and the distributions made to counties and the city of New York.

sponsored.t: Authorizes a study on proposed improvements of state route 303 in the town of Orangetown, county of Rockland
sponsored.sum: Authorizes and directs the department of transportation to conduct a study on proposed improvements of state route 303 in the town of Orangetown, county of Rockland.

sponsored.t: Increases Rockland county's annual minimum allocation through the MTA Dutchess-Orange-Rockland Fund (DORF)
sponsored.sum: Increases Rockland county's annual minimum allocation through the MTA Dutchess-Orange-Rockland Fund (DORF) from two million dollars to ten million dollars.

sponsored.t: Expands the criteria for a hate crime
sponsored.sum: Expands the criteria for a hate crime to include trespass committed at a house of worship.

sponsored.t: Establishes the fourteenth judicial district
sponsored.sum: Establishes the fourteenth judicial district which shall consist of the counties of Putnam, Dutchess, Orange and Rockland.

sponsored.t: Requires nonpublic schools to provide the same services that public schools currently provide to nonpublic schools; repealer
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "educational equity and choice act"; requires nonpublic schools to provide the same services that public schools currently provide to nonpublic schools; provides that such costs shall be approved by the commissioner of education and borne by the state; makes related provisions.

sponsored.t: Prohibits qualified immunity for public officials
sponsored.sum: Prohibits qualified immunity for public officials; authorizes attorney general enforcement; provides that statutory immunities and statutory limitations on liability, damages or attorney fees do not apply to such claims.

sponsored.t: Creates a religious exemption to the ban on fossil fuel equipment and systems
sponsored.sum: Provides an exemption for the purposes of allowing the installation and use of fossil-fuel equipment and building systems where such are installed and used in a building or part of a building that is owned or occupied by a person who holds genuine and sincere religious beliefs and whose health and safety will be jeopardized due to the prohibition of the installation of fossil-fuel equipment and building systems because of such genuine and sincere religious beliefs.

sponsored.t: Grants Rockland county residents who are charged the central business district toll a rebate
sponsored.sum: Grants Rockland county residents a rebate who are charged the central business district toll; establishes the "Rockland county central business district toll account".

sponsored.t: Relates to a joint report by the department of audit and control and the authorities budget office
sponsored.sum: Relates to a joint report by the department of audit and control and the authorities budget office on the financial and operational practices of any state authority whose purpose is to operate commuter transportation within the metropolitan commuter transportation district.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the granting of tuition assistance awards to any student who has knowingly engaged in certain antisemitic activities
sponsored.sum: Enacts "the combating campus antisemitism act"; prohibits the granting of tuition assistance awards to any student who has knowingly engaged in promoting antisemitism in a manner that is directed to inciting or producing imminent lawless action and is likely to incite or produce such action, that constitutes "true threats"; makes related provisions.

sponsored.t: Exempts antique motor vehicles from annual motor vehicle safety inspections
sponsored.sum: Exempts antique motor vehicles from annual motor vehicle safety inspections; modifies the definition of antique or historical motor vehicles.

sponsored.t: Allows boards of cooperative educational services to install school bus stop sign cameras
sponsored.sum: Allows boards of cooperative educational services to install school bus stop sign cameras.

sponsored.t: Grants a total exemption from real property taxation for school tax purposes for certain persons seventy-five years of age or over
sponsored.sum: Grants a total exemption from real property school tax for property owned by a person seventy-five years of age or older, or owned by spouses or siblings if one such person is seventy-five years of age or over, provided the owner has no children in the school district and has resided in the district for 30 years or more.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring the school district of East Ramapo to refund to taxpayers excess school taxes collected
sponsored.sum: Directs the tax levying body of East Ramapo and the East Ramapo Central School District to refund 2024-2025 school taxes collected as a result of an erroneous assertion that the district was facing a severe budget deficit.
sponsored.fis: The bill mandates that refunds be issued from existing surplus funds, ensuring no additional fiscal burden on taxpayers or state resources.

sponsored.t: Relates to providing a tax exemption for volunteer firefighters and volunteer ambulance workers
sponsored.sum: Relates to providing a tax exemption for volunteer firefighters and volunteer ambulance workers in a county with a population of more than 250,000 and less than 500,000 persons.

sponsored.t: Discontinues service fees for distinctive license plates issued to veterans
sponsored.sum: Discontinues service fees for distinctive license plates issued to veterans.

sponsored.t: Relates to the award of competitive civil service status for the spouse or children of military service persons killed in the line of duty
sponsored.sum: Relates to the award of competitive civil service status for the spouse or children of military service persons killed in the line of duty.

sponsored.t: Increases civil service credits given to veterans currently returning from service
sponsored.sum: Increases civil service credits given to veterans currently returning from service.

sponsored.t: Provides for any city, town or village in the state of New York to control the town speed limits
sponsored.sum: Provides for any city, town or village in the state of New York to control the town speed limits.

sponsored.t: Authorizes local school districts and municipalities to determine and establish school speed limits
sponsored.sum: Authorizes local school districts and municipalities to determine and establish school speed limits.

sponsored.t: Relates to additional credit allowed veterans in competitive examinations
sponsored.sum: Relates to additional credit allowed veterans in competitive examinations; expands the definition of "veteran" and "non-disabled veteran" to include the spouse and/or children of a member of the armed forces of the United States who served therein in time of war and was subsequently killed in the line of duty.

sponsored.t: Relates to disability retirement benefits for Dennis Malone, a participant in World Trade Center rescue, recovery, and cleanup operations
sponsored.sum: Entitles Dennis Malone, an employee of the Town of Clarkstown who retired from such service on August 16, 2018, and who participated in the World Trade Center rescue, recovery and cleanup operations to a 75% accidental disability retirement benefit.

sponsored.t: Requires employers to offer paid leave of absence to veterans on Veterans' day
sponsored.sum: Requires employers to offer paid leave of absence to veterans on Veterans' day, except for emergency or critical employees, who shall be offered another day of paid leave.

sponsored.t: Permits public schools to utilize or display indigenous names
sponsored.sum: Permits public schools to utilize or display indigenous names.

sponsored.t: Relates to the payroll tax of the metropolitan commuter transportation district
sponsored.sum: Excludes the counties of Orange and Rockland from the payroll tax of the metropolitan commuter transportation district.

sponsored.t: Grants retroactive tier IV membership in the New York state and local employees' retirement system to Raymond Ruckel
sponsored.sum: Grants retroactive tier IV membership in the New York state and local employees' retirement system to Raymond Ruckel.

sponsored.t: Authorizes Thomas Collins to file a request for change of benefit coverage with the New York state teachers' retirement system
sponsored.sum: Authorizes Thomas Collins to file a request for change of benefit coverage with the New York state teachers' retirement system.

sponsored.t: Relates to requirements for a course of instruction relating to the Holocaust and genocide
sponsored.sum: Provides specific requirements for a course of instruction relating to the Holocaust and genocide.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the town of Ramapo to establish a school speed zone demonstration program
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the town of Ramapo to establish a school speed zone demonstration program; authorizes installation in no more than twenty school speed zones in such town.

sponsored.t: Relates to criminal impersonation in the first degree
sponsored.sum: Includes impersonation of a firefighter in the definition of criminal impersonation in the first degree.

sponsored.t: Establishes a real property tax freeze credit
sponsored.sum: Establishes a real property tax freeze credit for taxpayers in certain eligible school districts.
sponsored.fis: This bill will save homeowners over $2.5 billion over 3 years.

sponsored.t: Relates to the payment of salaries to members of the legislature and the governor in the event of a late passage of the state budget
sponsored.sum: Provides that if legislative passage of the budget has not occurred prior to the first day of any fiscal year, the bi-weekly salary installment payments of the governor and members of the legislature to be paid on or after such day shall be withheld and forfeited in perpetuity until such legislative passage of the budget has occurred.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the county of Rockland to offer an optional twenty year retirement plan to John F. Leonard, Jr., a deputy sheriff employed by such county
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the county of Rockland to offer an optional twenty year retirement plan to John F. Leonard, Jr., a deputy sheriff employed by such county.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the county of Rockland to offer an optional twenty year retirement plan to Matthew Donovan, a deputy sheriff employed by such county
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the county of Rockland to offer an optional twenty year retirement plan to Matthew Donovan, a deputy sheriff employed by such county.

sponsored.t: Authorizes Yeshivas Nachlas Sofrim to receive retroactive real property tax exempt status
sponsored.sum: Authorizes Yeshivas Nachlas Sofrim to receive retroactive real property tax exempt status.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the assessor of the town of Ramapo to accept an application for a real property tax exemption from Lev Teen Center
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the assessor of the town of Ramapo, county of Rockland, to accept an application for a real property tax exemption from Lev Teen Center.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the county of Rockland to impose an additional rate of sales and compensating use taxes
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the county of Rockland to impose an additional rate of sales and compensating use taxes until November 30, 2027.

sponsored.t: Makes a technical change to the tax law; extends the village of Nyack occupancy tax
sponsored.sum: Makes a technical change to the tax law; extends the authorization of the village of Nyack to impose an occupancy tax.

sponsored.t: Relates to community preservation funds for the town of Orangetown
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the town of Orangetown to establish community preservation funds; establishes a real estate transfer tax with revenues therefrom to be deposited in said community preservation fund; provides for the repeal of such provisions upon the expiration thereof.

sponsored.t: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system in the town of Haverstraw, county of Rockland to Hector L. Soto
sponsored.sum: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system in the town of Haverstraw, county of Rockland to Hector L. Soto.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the Thiells-Roseville Fire District to file an application for exemption from school taxes and real property taxes
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the Thiells-Roseville Fire District to file an application for exemption from school taxes and real property taxes.

sponsored.t: Limiting the shift between classes of taxable property in the town of Haverstraw, county of Rockland
sponsored.sum: Relates to limiting the shift between classes of taxable property in the town of Haverstraw, county of Rockland for 2025-2026.

sponsored.t: Extends limitations on the shift between classes of taxable property in the town of Clarkstown, county of Rockland
sponsored.sum: Extends limitations on the shift between classes of taxable property in the town of Clarkstown, county of Rockland for an additional year.

sponsored.t: Extends limitations on the shift between classes of taxable property in the town of Orangetown, County of Rockland
sponsored.sum: Extends limitations on the shift between classes of taxable property in the town of Orangetown, County of Rockland for the 2025--2026 assessment rolls.
